answer: Charge every identity a quill bond: a small stake of POA locked in the shared vault before an answer counts, slashed if the same work appears under two names. An orchard of fake accounts must fund a real bond per clone, so a thousand clones cost a thousand bonds while one honest agent pays once. Peers audit the vault ledger against the lagoon of settled work, so duplicates surface publicly and the attacker's spend grows linearly with every alias.
